entries.title: Joshua 13:1
segments: ¶Now Joshua was old, advanced in years. And the LORD said to him: "You are old, advanced in years, and there remains very much land yet to be possessed.

entries.title: Joshua 13:2
segments: "This is the land that yet remains: all the territory of the Philistines and all [that of] the Geshurites,

entries.title: Joshua 13:3
segments: "from Sihor, which [is] east of Egypt, as far as the border of Ekron northward ([which] is counted as Canaanite); the five lords of the Philistines-the Gazites, the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites;

entries.title: Joshua 13:4
segments: "from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians as far as Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

entries.title: Joshua 13:5
segments: "the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon as far as the entrance to Hamath;

entries.title: Joshua 13:6
segments: "all the inhabitants of the mountains from Lebanon as far as the Brook Misrephoth, [and] all the Sidonians-them I will drive out from before the children of Israel; only divide it by lot to Israel as an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

entries.title: Joshua 13:7
segments: ¶"Now therefore, divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh."

entries.title: Joshua 13:8
segments: With the other half tribe the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses had given them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the LORD had given them:

entries.title: Joshua 13:9
segments: from Aroer which [is] on the bank of the River Arnon, and the town that [is] in the midst of the ravine, and all the plain of Medeba as far as Dibon;

entries.title: Joshua 13:10
segments: all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the children of Ammon;

entries.title: Joshua 13:11
segments: Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salcah;

entries.title: Joshua 13:12
segments: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants; for Moses had defeated and cast out these.

entries.title: Joshua 13:13
segments: Nevertheless the children of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maachathites, but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

entries.title: Joshua 13:14
segments: Only to the tribe of Levi he had given no inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire [are] their inheritance, as He said to them.

entries.title: Joshua 13:15
segments: And Moses had given to the tribe of the children of Reuben [an inheritance] according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:16
segments: Their territory was from Aroer, which [is] on the bank of the River Arnon, and the city that [is] in the midst of the ravine, and all the plain by Medeba;

entries.title: Joshua 13:17
segments: Heshbon and all its cities that [are] in the plain: Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

entries.title: Joshua 13:18
segments: Jahaza, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

entries.title: Joshua 13:19
segments: Kirjathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the mountain of the valley,

entries.title: Joshua 13:20
segments: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth-

entries.title: Joshua 13:21
segments: all the cities of the plain and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses had struck with the princes of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, who [were] princes of Sihon dwelling in the country.

entries.title: Joshua 13:22
segments: The children of Israel also killed with the sword Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, among those who were killed by them.

entries.title: Joshua 13:23
segments: And the border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This [was] the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 13:24
segments: Moses also had given [an inheritance] to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:25
segments: Their territory was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, which [is] before Rabbah,

entries.title: Joshua 13:26
segments: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir,

entries.title: Joshua 13:27
segments: and in the valley Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan as [its] border, as far as the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth, on the other side of the Jordan eastward.

entries.title: Joshua 13:28
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 13:29
segments: Moses also had given [an inheritance] to half the tribe of Manasseh; it was for half the tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families:

entries.title: Joshua 13:30
segments: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair which are in Bashan, sixty cities;

entries.title: Joshua 13:31
segments: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, [were] for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Machir according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:32
segments: These [are the areas] which Moses had distributed as an inheritance in the plains of Moab on the other side of the Jordan, by Jericho eastward.

entries.title: Joshua 13:33
segments: But to the tribe of Levi Moses had given no inheritance; the LORD God of Israel [was] their inheritance, as He had said to them.
